successors.name: Chu
successors.text: Ju County, Shandong, the capital named on the page ('south-eastern Shandong around modern Juxian' in the chu dossier)

ledger.x: 1046 BC: King Wu of Zhou enfeoffs Zi Yuqi at Ju.
431 BC: the state of Ju ends in Chu's conquest.

wars.name: Chu conquest of Ju
wars.outcome: Ju conquered by Chu in 431 BC (infobox); 'weakened by wars with the states of Chu and Qi'.

certainty.note: No Ju boundary is on the page; soft throughout.
